+"""E/T020: receipt-shape gate; synthetic unit tests, NOT a gameplay emulator."""
+import unittest
+
+REQUIRED_STAGES = ("g0", "g1", "g2", "g3", "g4")
+REQUIRED_HASHES = ("old_exe", "old_save", "old_dat", "old_map", "old_input")
+
+def gate(r):
+    if not r.get("old_observed"):
+        return "DESIGNED_NOT_RUN"
+    runs = [r.get("stage_runs", {}).get(k) for k in REQUIRED_STAGES]
+    if any(v is None for v in runs) or len(set(runs)) != 1:
+        return "REJECT_EVIDENCE"
+    if not all(r.get("old_hashes", {}).get(k) for k in REQUIRED_HASHES):
+        return "REJECT_EVIDENCE"
+    if not all(r.get("captures", {}).get(k) for k in REQUIRED_STAGES):
+        return "VERIFY"
+    if r.get("commit_paths") == ["native", "new_api"] or r.get("commit_paths") == ["new_api", "native"]:
+        return "REJECT_DOUBLE_COMMIT"
+    if r.get("commit_paths") not in (["native"], ["new_api"]):
+        return "VERIFY"
+    if r.get("route_evidence") != "DYNAMIC_OBSERVED":
+        return "VERIFY"
+    if not r.get("new_build_sha") or not r.get("new_capture_sha"):
+        return "NO_STRICT_COMPARISON"
+    return "SYNTHETIC_SCHEMA_READY" if r.get("synthetic") else "READY_FOR_COMPARISON"
+
+class BattleEndGateTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def base(self):
+        return dict(synthetic=True, old_observed=True,
+                    stage_runs={k: "r1" for k in REQUIRED_STAGES},
+                    old_hashes={k: "present" for k in REQUIRED_HASHES},
+                    captures={k: "capture" for k in REQUIRED_STAGES},
+                    commit_paths=["native"], route_evidence="DYNAMIC_OBSERVED",
+                    new_build_sha="present", new_capture_sha="present")
+
+    def test_no_old_observation(self):
+        r=self.base(); r["old_observed"]=False
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "DESIGNED_NOT_RUN")
+
+    def test_missing_world_capture(self):
+        r=self.base(); r["captures"]["g4"]=None
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "VERIFY")
+
+    def test_cross_session(self):
+        r=self.base(); r["stage_runs"]["g4"]="r2"
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "REJECT_EVIDENCE")
+
+    def test_double_commit(self):
+        r=self.base(); r["commit_paths"]=["native","new_api"]
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "REJECT_DOUBLE_COMMIT")
+
+    def test_static_route_not_observed(self):
+        r=self.base(); r["route_evidence"]="STATIC"
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "VERIFY")
+
+    def test_missing_new_build(self):
+        r=self.base(); r["new_build_sha"]=None
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "NO_STRICT_COMPARISON")
+
+    def test_missing_old_hash(self):
+        r=self.base(); r["old_hashes"]["old_save"]=None
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "REJECT_EVIDENCE")
+
+    def test_full_synthetic_is_not_gameplay_match(self):
+        r=self.base()
+        self.assertEqual(gate(r), "SYNTHETIC_SCHEMA_READY")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""T020: byte-bind receipt paths to real files. Never declares gameplay PASS."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import re
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+EXE_SHA = "E8DAC301050C8E630D7E0CE93AEEFD95E641207D9C0576017F62BA46A8767187"
+ROLES = ("old_exe", "old_save", "old_dat", "old_map", "old_input",
+         "g0", "g1", "g2", "g3", "g4", "new_build", "new_capture")
+HEX64 = re.compile(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{64}\Z")
+
+def digest(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open("rb") as f:
+        for piece in iter(lambda: f.read(65536), b""):
+            h.update(piece)
+    return h.hexdigest().upper()
+
+def verify(root, receipt):
+    """Independent byte gate, not a claim about who captured any bytes."""
+    items = receipt.get("evidence")
+    if not isinstance(items, dict) or set(items) != set(ROLES):
+        return "REJECT_FIELDS"
+    if not all(isinstance(items[role], dict) for role in ROLES):
+        return "REJECT_FIELDS"
+    synthetic = receipt.get("synthetic") is True
+    if not synthetic and items["old_exe"].get("sha256", "").upper() != EXE_SHA:
+        return "REJECT_EXE_ID"
+    root = Path(root).resolve(strict=True)
+    seen = set()
+    for role in ROLES:
+        item = items[role]
+        if not isinstance(item, dict):
+            return "REJECT_FIELDS:" + role
+        name, expected = item.get("path"), item.get("sha256")
+        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not isinstance(expected, str):
+            return "REJECT_FIELDS:" + role
+        if HEX64.fullmatch(expected) is None:
+            return "REJECT_HASH_FORMAT:" + role
+        rel = Path(name)
+        if rel.is_absolute() or ".." in rel.parts or "." == name:
+            return "REJECT_PATH:" + role
+        key = str(rel).casefold()
+        if key in seen:
+            return "REJECT_DUPLICATE_PATH:" + role
+        seen.add(key)
+        p = root / rel
+        try:
+            if any((root / Path(*rel.parts[:i])).is_symlink()
+                   for i in range(1, len(rel.parts) + 1)):
+                return "REJECT_SYMLINK:" + role
+            resolved = p.resolve(strict=True)
+            if not resolved.is_relative_to(root):
+                return "REJECT_PATH:" + role
+            if not resolved.is_file():
+                return "REJECT_NOT_FILE:" + role
+            if digest(resolved) != expected.upper():
+                return "HASH_MISMATCH:" + role
+        except (OSError, ValueError):
+            return "MISSING_OR_UNREADABLE:" + role
+    return "BYTE_BOUND_SYNTHETIC" if synthetic else "BYTE_BOUND_NOT_GOLDEN"
+
+class ByteBindingTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
+        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
+        self.items = {}
+        for role in ROLES:
+            name = "receipts/" + role + ".bin"
+            p = self.root / name
+            p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            p.write_bytes(role.encode("ascii"))
+            self.items[role] = {"path": name, "sha256": digest(p)}
+        self.receipt = {"synthetic": True, "evidence": self.items}
+
+    def tearDown(self):
+        self.tmp.cleanup()
+
+    def check(self, expected):
+        self.assertEqual(verify(self.root, self.receipt), expected)
+
+    def test_byte_bound_synthetic_not_golden(self):
+        self.check("BYTE_BOUND_SYNTHETIC")
+
+    def test_mutated_save_bytes(self):
+        (self.root / self.items["old_save"]["path"]).write_bytes(b"changed")
+        self.check("HASH_MISMATCH:old_save")
+
+    def test_placeholder_digest(self):
+        self.items["old_input"]["sha256"] = "present"
+        self.check("REJECT_HASH_FORMAT:old_input")
+
+    def test_missing_capture(self):
+        (self.root / self.items["g4"]["path"]).unlink()
+        self.check("MISSING_OR_UNREADABLE:g4")
+
+    def test_cross_role_path_reuse(self):
+        self.items["g3"] = dict(self.items["g2"])
+        self.check("REJECT_DUPLICATE_PATH:g3")
+
+    def test_escape_above_root(self):
+        self.items["old_dat"]["path"] = "../outside.dat"
+        self.check("REJECT_PATH:old_dat")
+
+    def test_absolute_path(self):
+        self.items["old_map"]["path"] = str((self.root / "outside").resolve())
+        self.check("REJECT_PATH:old_map")
+
+    def test_symlink_rejected(self):
+        target = self.root / self.items["g0"]["path"]
+        link = self.root / "receipts/linked.bin"
+        try:
+            link.symlink_to(target)
+        except (OSError, NotImplementedError):
+            self.skipTest("symlink unavailable")
+        self.items["g0"]["path"] = "receipts/linked.bin"
+        self.check("REJECT_SYMLINK:g0")
+
+    def test_missing_required_role(self):
+        self.items.pop("g1")
+        self.check("REJECT_FIELDS")
+
+    def test_malformed_exe_receipt(self):
+        self.items["old_exe"] = "not a record"
+        self.receipt["synthetic"] = False
+        self.check("REJECT_FIELDS")
+
+    def test_non_synthetic_wrong_exe_id(self):
+        self.receipt["synthetic"] = False
+        self.check("REJECT_EXE_ID")
+
+    def test_stage_capture_content_changed(self):
+        (self.root / self.items["g2"]["path"]).write_bytes(b"another frame")
+        self.check("HASH_MISMATCH:g2")
+
+    def test_directory_not_file(self):
+        self.items["new_capture"]["path"] = "receipts"
+        self.check("REJECT_NOT_FILE:new_capture")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+"""E-only archived watch failure-class and coverage regression (no game execution)."""
+from pathlib import Path
+from datetime import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import statistics
+import unittest
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "rea_lab" / "headless_analysis" / "search_index"
+CASES = {
+ "watch1": ("BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_23272_20261021T142710802580Z.jsonl",
+            "9DF9A0D8C7D15958F4711478ED6DFF1F912E49313D6FC5BA5DCBC5B089E262A7", 234,
+            "SnapshotError", "unexpected nil tree node"),
+ "watch2": ("BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_V2_23272_20261021T151336188087Z.jsonl",
+            "1D60CC8CDC6D3B9F020FB52238C3A714F069EA4A4B489F874D90F41FEEE74B46", 85,
+            "ValueError", "Unbounded memory request")
+}
+def inspect(case):
+    name, sha, n, typ, reason = case
+    raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
+    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper() == sha, "source SHA drift"
+    entries = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    assert len(entries) == n, "row count drift"
+    gaps = [e for e in entries if e.get("kind") == "CAPTURE_VERIFY_GAP"]
+    events = [(datetime.fromisoformat(e["utc"]), e.get("state", e.get("snapshot", {})))
+              for e in entries if isinstance(e.get("state", e.get("snapshot", {})), dict)]
+    active = next(t for t,s in events if s.get("mode")==2 and s.get("active")==1)
+    inactive = next(t for t,s in events if t>active and s.get("active")==0)
+    stamps = [datetime.fromisoformat(e["utc"]) for e in gaps]
+    return entries, gaps, stamps, active, inactive
+
+class ArchivedFailureGate(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_provenance_and_rowcounts(self):
+        for c in CASES.values():
+            entries, gaps, *_ = inspect(c)
+            self.assertEqual(len(entries), c[2])
+            self.assertEqual(len(gaps), 28)
+    def test_failure_class_is_not_reason_only(self):
+        types = []
+        for c in CASES.values():
+            _, gaps, *_ = inspect(c)
+            self.assertEqual([g["attempt"] for g in gaps], list(range(1,29)))
+            self.assertEqual({(g["error_type"],g["reason"]) for g in gaps}, {(c[3],c[4])})
+            types.append(c[3])
+        self.assertEqual(len(set(types)), 2)
+    def test_strictly_increasing_attempt_clock(self):
+        for c in CASES.values():
+            _, _, stamps, *_ = inspect(c)
+            deltas = [(b-a).total_seconds() for a,b in zip(stamps,stamps[1:])]
+            self.assertEqual(len(deltas),27)
+            self.assertTrue(all(x>0 for x in deltas))
+    def test_observed_active_bracket_not_full_capture(self):
+        for label,c in CASES.items():
+            _, gaps, stamps, active, inactive = inspect(c)
+            self.assertLessEqual(active, stamps[0])
+            self.assertLess(stamps[-1], inactive)
+            span=(inactive-active).total_seconds()
+            attempt_window=(stamps[-1]-stamps[0]).total_seconds()
+            self.assertLess(attempt_window/span,0.15)
+            print(f"{label}: class={c[3]}, reason={c[4]},"
+                  f" attempt_window={attempt_window:.6f}s,"
+                  f" active_to_first_inactive={span:.6f}s,"
+                  f" attempt_window_ratio={attempt_window/span:.4%},"
+                  f" last_gap_to_inactive={(inactive-stamps[-1]).total_seconds():.6f}s")
+    def test_byte_change_cannot_keep_provenance(self):

+     "1D60CC8CDC6D3B9F020FB52238C3A714F069EA4A4B489F874D90F41FEEE74B46", 85),
+)
+
+def when(record):
+    return dt.datetime.fromisoformat(record["utc"])
+
+def state(record):
+    return record.get("state", record.get("initial", record.get("snapshot")))
+
+def analyze(name, sha, expected_rows):
+    raw = (SOURCE / name).read_bytes()
+    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper() != sha:
+        raise AssertionError("SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    if len(rows) != expected_rows:
+        raise AssertionError("ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH")
+    active = [r for r in rows if isinstance(state(r), dict)
+              and state(r).get("mode") == 2 and state(r).get("active") == 1]
+    gaps = [r for r in rows if r.get("kind") == "CAPTURE_VERIFY_GAP"]
+    exit_candidates = [r for r in rows if r.get("kind") == "STATE_CHANGE"
+                       and isinstance(state(r), dict)
+                       and state(r).get("mode") == 2 and state(r).get("active") == 0
+                       and active and when(r) > when(active[-1])]
+    if not active or not gaps or not exit_candidates:
+        raise AssertionError("MISSING_ACTIVE_GAP_OR_EXIT")
+    enter, exit_state = active[0], exit_candidates[0]
+    attempts = [r.get("attempt") for r in gaps]
+    if attempts != list(range(1, len(gaps) + 1)):
+        raise AssertionError("GAP_ATTEMPT_SEQUENCE")
+    if not (when(enter) <= when(gaps[0]) <= when(gaps[-1]) < when(exit_state)):
+        raise AssertionError("GAP_OUTSIDE_ACTIVE_WINDOW")
+    sec = lambda a, b: round((when(b) - when(a)).total_seconds(), 6)
+    return dict(name=name, row_count=len(rows), gap_count=len(gaps),
+                first_attempt=when(gaps[0]).isoformat(), last_attempt=when(gaps[-1]).isoformat(),
+                start_active=when(enter).isoformat(), first_inactive=when(exit_state).isoformat(),
+                failures_by_reason=dict(collections.Counter(r.get("reason") for r in gaps)),
+                seconds_attempt_span=sec(gaps[0], gaps[-1]),

+                seconds_unobserved_attempts_to_inactive=sec(gaps[-1], exit_state),

+"""E T020: replay two archived native watch logs, not a Golden acceptance runner."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+import unittest
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).parents[1] / "rea_lab" / "headless_analysis" / "search_index"
+SOURCES = (
+    ("BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_23272_20261021T142710802580Z.jsonl",
+     "9DF9A0D8C7D15958F4711478ED6DFF1F912E49313D6FC5BA5DCBC5B089E262A7", 234),
+    ("BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_V2_23272_20261021T151336188087Z.jsonl",
+     "1D60CC8CDC6D3B9F020FB52238C3A714F069EA4A4B489F874D90F41FEEE74B46", 85),
+)
+
+def load_source(spec):
+    name, sha, count = spec
+    raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
+    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper() == sha, "source SHA mismatch"
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines()]
+    assert len(rows) == count, "record count mismatch"
+    return rows
+
+def samples(rows):
+    return [{"utc": r["utc"], **(r.get("state") or r.get("initial"))}
+            for r in rows if r.get("state") or r.get("initial")]
+
+def edge_pairs(s, key):
+    return [(p, c) for p, c in zip(s, s[1:]) if p[key] != c[key]]
+
+def first_edge(s, key, old, new):
+    return next((p, c) for p, c in edge_pairs(s, key)
+                if p[key] == old and c[key] == new)
+
+def seconds(a, b):
+    return (datetime.fromisoformat(b) - datetime.fromisoformat(a)).total_seconds()
+
+class DualWatchReplay(unittest.TestCase):
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls):
+        cls.rows = tuple(load_source(s) for s in SOURCES)
+        cls.s = tuple(samples(r) for r in cls.rows)
+
+    def test_01_hashes_and_rows(self):
+        self.assertEqual(tuple(map(len, self.rows)), (234, 85))
+        self.assertGreater(len(self.s[0]), 100)
+        self.assertGreater(len(self.s[1]), 40)
+
+    def test_02_watch_sessions_do_not_overlap(self):
+        self.assertLess(self.rows[0][-1]["utc"], self.rows[1][0]["utc"])
+        self.assertNotEqual(SOURCES[0][1], SOURCES[1][1])
+
+    def test_03_watch1_attack_count_reverses_before_mode2(self):
+        s = self.s[0]; enter = first_edge(s, "mode", 1, 2)[1]["utc"]
+        seq = [(p["attack_count"], c["attack_count"])
+               for p, c in edge_pairs(s, "attack_count") if c["utc"] < enter]
+        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(seq), 10)
+        self.assertTrue(any(a > b for a, b in seq))
+        self.assertTrue(any(a < b for a, b in seq))
+
+    def test_04_watch2_count_changes_while_mode1(self):
+        s = self.s[1]; p, c = first_edge(s, "attack_count", 1, 2)
+        self.assertEqual((p["mode"], c["mode"], c["active"]), (1, 1, 0))
+        m, _ = first_edge(s, "mode", 1, 2)
+        self.assertGreater(seconds(c["utc"], m["utc"]), 1.5)
+
+    def test_05_four_mode_active_edges_each(self):
+        for s in self.s:
+            with self.subTest(first=s[0]["utc"]):
+                for k, a, b in (("mode", 1, 2), ("active", 0, 1),
+                                ("active", 1, 0), ("mode", 2, 1)):
+                    self.assertIsNotNone(first_edge(s, k, a, b))
+
+    def test_06_second_watch_preactive_bounds(self):
+        s = self.s[1]
+        m0, m1 = first_edge(s, "mode", 1, 2)
+        a0, a1 = first_edge(s, "active", 0, 1)
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(seconds(m1["utc"], a0["utc"]), 0.402292, 6)
+        self.assertAlmostEqual(seconds(m0["utc"], a1["utc"]), 3.923619, 6)
+
+    def test_07_world_mode_transient_both_watches(self):
+        for s in self.s:
+            with self.subTest(first=s[0]["utc"]):
+                flips = [(p["world_mode"], c["world_mode"])
+                         for p, c in edge_pairs(s, "world_mode")]
+                self.assertEqual(flips, [(0, 1), (1, 0), (0, 1), (1, 0)])
+
+    def test_08_no_complete_packet_in_either_watch(self):
+        for rows in self.rows:
+            with self.subTest(first=rows[0]["utc"]):
+                self.assertEqual(sum(r["kind"] == "CAPTURE_VERIFY_GAP" for r in rows), 28)
+                self.assertFalse(any(r.get("captures_saved", 0) for r in rows))
+                self.assertFalse(any(r.get("native_finish_commit_verified", False) for r in rows))
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
+

+"""E/T020: cross-role visible Unit/Troop label alias review; synthetic only."""
+import copy
+import unittest
+from collections import defaultdict
+import t020_cnb02_g2_unhashable_role_failclosed_20261026_11H as prior11
+
+ROLES = frozenset(("attack", "defense", "support"))
+FLAGS = ("CROSS_ROLE_VISIBLE_PAIR_ALIAS_REVIEW",
+         "CROSS_ROLE_VISIBLE_UNIT_ALIAS_REVIEW",
+         "CROSS_ROLE_VISIBLE_TROOP_ALIAS_REVIEW")
+
+def review(g2):
+    upstream = prior11.review(g2)
+    issues = set(upstream["issues"])
+    pairs, units, troops = defaultdict(set), defaultdict(set), defaultdict(set)
+    rows = g2.get("roster") if isinstance(g2, dict) else None
+    for row in rows if isinstance(rows, list) else []:
+        if not isinstance(row, dict):
+            continue
+        role, unit, troop = (row.get(k) for k in ("side", "unit_visible", "troop_visible"))
+        if not isinstance(role, str) or role not in ROLES:
+            continue
+        if not all(isinstance(x, str) and x.strip() for x in (unit, troop)):
+            continue
+        pairs[(unit, troop)].add(role)
+        units[unit].add(role)
+        troops[troop].add(role)
+    for mapping, flag in zip((pairs, units, troops), FLAGS):
+        if any(len(role_set) > 1 for role_set in mapping.values()):
+            issues.add(flag)
+    return dict(upstream, issues=sorted(issues), verdict="VERIFY_NOT_GOLDEN",
+                actual_golden_pass=False, strict_match=False,
+                coverage="CROSS_ROLE_VISIBLE_LABEL_AMBIGUITY_ONLY")
+
+class CrossRoleAliasTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def base(self):
+        return prior11.parity10.old11.synthetic_candidate()["stages"]["g2"]
+    def assert_flag(self, g2, flag):
+        before = copy.deepcopy(g2)
+        got = review(g2)
+        self.assertEqual(g2, before)
+        self.assertIn(flag, got["issues"])
+        self.assertEqual(got["verdict"], "VERIFY_NOT_GOLDEN")
+        self.assertFalse(got["actual_golden_pass"])
+        self.assertFalse(got["strict_match"])
+
+    def test_baseline_no_alias(self):
+        self.assertFalse(set(review(self.base())["issues"]) & set(FLAGS))
+    def test_prior_has_no_cross_role_alias_warning(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"][1].update(unit_visible="u_attack", troop_visible="t_attack")
+        self.assertEqual(prior11.review(g)["issues"], [])
+        self.assertIn(FLAGS[0], review(g)["issues"])
+    def test_attack_defense_same_pair(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"][1].update(unit_visible="u_attack", troop_visible="t_attack")
+        for flag in FLAGS: self.assert_flag(g, flag)
+    def test_same_unit_different_troops(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"][1]["unit_visible"] = "u_attack"
+        out = review(g)["issues"]
+        self.assertIn(FLAGS[1], out); self.assertNotIn(FLAGS[0], out)
+    def test_same_troop_different_units(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"][1]["troop_visible"] = "t_attack"
+        out = review(g)["issues"]
+        self.assertIn(FLAGS[2], out); self.assertNotIn(FLAGS[0], out)
+    def test_attack_support_same_pair_needs_review(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"].append(dict(g["roster"][0], side="support"))
+        self.assert_flag(g, FLAGS[0])
+    def test_same_role_duplicate_still_from_previous(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"].append(dict(g["roster"][0]))
+        self.assert_flag(g, "DUPLICATE_ROSTER_REFERENCE_VERIFY")
+        self.assertFalse(set(review(g)["issues"]) & set(FLAGS))
+    def test_nontext_id_fails_previous_and_no_alias(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"][1].update(unit_visible=4, troop_visible="t_attack")
+        self.assert_flag(g, "ROSTER_IDS_NOT_TEXT")
+        self.assertFalse(set(review(g)["issues"]) & set(FLAGS))
+    def test_unhashable_role_still_fails_closed(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"][0]["side"] = ["attack"]
+        self.assert_flag(g, "ROSTER_ROLE_UNHASHABLE_VERIFY")
+    def test_non_object_input_fails_closed(self):
+        out = review(None)
+        self.assertEqual(out["verdict"], "VERIFY_NOT_GOLDEN")
+        self.assertFalse(out["actual_golden_pass"])
+    def test_distinct_case_is_not_equated_as_native_identity(self):
+        g = self.base(); g["roster"][1].update(unit_visible="U_ATTACK", troop_visible="T_ATTACK")
+        self.assertFalse(set(review(g)["issues"]) & set(FLAGS))
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+PLACEHOLDERS = frozenset({
+    "unknown", "placeholder", "unverified", "tbd", "to_be_confirmed",
+    "observed-unit", "observed-troop", "observed-power",
+    "synthetic-unit", "synthetic-troop", "synthetic-power", "<missing>",
+})
+NEW_FLAGS = {
+    "unit_visible": "G2_UNIT_ID_PLACEHOLDER_REVIEW",
+    "troop_visible": "G2_TROOP_ID_PLACEHOLDER_REVIEW",
+}
+PARTICIPANT_FLAG = "G2_SIDE_PARTICIPANT_PLACEHOLDER_REVIEW"
+
+
+def is_placeholder(value):
+    return isinstance(value, str) and value.strip().casefold() in PLACEHOLDERS
+
+
+def review(g2):
+    before = previous.review(g2)
+    issues = set(before["issues"])
+    if isinstance(g2, dict):
+        for row in g2.get("roster", []) if isinstance(g2.get("roster"), list) else []:
+            if isinstance(row, dict):
+                for field, flag in NEW_FLAGS.items():
+                    if is_placeholder(row.get(field)):
+                        issues.add(flag)
+        sides = g2.get("sides")
+        if isinstance(sides, dict):
+            for members in sides.values():
+                if isinstance(members, list) and any(is_placeholder(x) for x in members):
+                    issues.add(PARTICIPANT_FLAG)
+    return dict(before, issues=sorted(issues), verdict="VERIFY_NOT_GOLDEN",
+                actual_golden_pass=False, strict_match=False,
+                coverage="VISIBLE_LABELS_ONLY_NOT_NATIVE_IDENTITY")

+    def check(self, mutate, flag):

+        self.assertFalse(out["strict_match"])

+    def test_attack_unit_unknown(self):

+                   NEW_FLAGS["unit_visible"])
+
+    def test_prior_did_not_flag_visible_placeholder(self):
+        g = self.base()
+        g["roster"][0]["unit_visible"] = "unknown"

+    def test_defense_troop_placeholder(self):

+    def test_attack_unit_observed_placeholder(self):
+        self.check(lambda g: g["roster"][0].update(unit_visible="observed-unit"),
+                   NEW_FLAGS["unit_visible"])
+
+    def test_both_aliases_are_reviewed(self):
+        g = self.base()
+        g["roster"][0].update(unit_visible="TBD", troop_visible="synthetic-troop")

+    def test_support_power_placeholder_review(self):

+    def test_attack_participant_placeholder_review(self):

+"""E/T018/T020 G2 synthetic declaration-vs-deployment gap guard.
+
+Follow-on to EXISTING research ID E-OFFLINE-20261101-09H-T018-T020-G2-BIJECTION-ORDER-01.
+This is a schema-only policy check of modeled receipts, not any newly recovered
+original PC report, native source proof, independent original-game observation,
+Golden, MATCH, READY, or a B-owner native finding.
+
+It addresses a narrow gap in previously published E synthetic role-presence
+checks: a well-shaped deployed combat row can coexist with an empty declared
+attack/defense side list (or vice versa), without producing a relation warning.
+Only existence is checked. Matching role labels DO NOT bind Power participants to
+runtime Unit/Troop identities; that still needs independently attested same-run
+original evidence and cannot be verified by this code.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import unittest
+
+ROLES = ("attack", "defense", "support")
+
+
+def _label(value):
+    return type(value) is str and bool(value.strip())
+
+
+def review(g2):
+    """Return conservative presence-mismatch diagnostics; never a native verdict."""
+    result = {
+        "classification": "SYNTHETIC_ROLE_RELATION_ONLY",
+        "issues": [],
+        "relation_attested": False,
+        "actual_golden_pass": False,
+        "strict_match": False,
+        "ready": False,
+    }
+    issues = set()
+    if type(g2) is not dict:
+        issues.add("G2_NOT_OBJECT")
+        result["issues"] = sorted(issues)
+        return result
+    sides, roster = g2.get("sides"), g2.get("roster")
+    if type(sides) is not dict or set(sides) != set(ROLES):
+        issues.add("SIDE_SCHEMA")
+    if type(roster) is not list:
+        issues.add("ROSTER_SCHEMA")
+    if "SIDE_SCHEMA" in issues or "ROSTER_SCHEMA" in issues:
+        result["issues"] = sorted(issues)
+        return result
+
+    declaration = {}
+    for role in ROLES:
+        participants = sides[role]
+        if type(participants) is not list or not all(_label(v) for v in participants):
+            issues.add("INVALID_SIDE_DECLARATION_" + role.upper())
+            declaration[role] = None
+        else:
+            declaration[role] = bool(participants)
+            if len(set(participants)) != len(participants):
+                issues.add("DUPLICATE_SIDE_DECLARATION_" + role.upper())
+
+    deployed = {role: False for role in ROLES}
+    for row in roster:
+        if type(row) is not dict:
+            issues.add("ROSTER_ROW_UNTYPED")
+            continue
+        side = row.get("side")
+        if not _label(side) or side not in ROLES:
+            issues.add("ROSTER_SIDE_INVALID")
+            continue
+        if not _label(row.get("unit_visible")) or not _label(row.get("troop_visible")):
+            issues.add("ROSTER_ROW_UNTYPED")
+            continue
+        deployed[side] = True
+
+    for role in ROLES:
+        if declaration[role] is True and not deployed[role]:
+            issues.add("DECLARED_WITHOUT_DEPLOYED_" + role.upper())
+        elif declaration[role] is False and deployed[role]:
+            issues.add("DEPLOYED_WITHOUT_DECLARED_" + role.upper())
+
+    result["issues"] = sorted(issues)
+    return result
+
+
+class DeclaredVsDeployedSyntheticTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    @staticmethod
+    def baseline():
+        return {
+            "map_id": "synthetic-map-label",
+            "sides": {"attack": ["power-a"], "defense": ["power-d"], "support": []},
+            "roster": [
+                {"side": "attack", "unit_visible": "unit-a", "troop_visible": "troop-a"},
+                {"side": "defense", "unit_visible": "unit-d", "troop_visible": "troop-d"},
+            ],
+        }
+
+    def check(self, candidate, *flags):
+        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
+        r = review(candidate)
+        self.assertEqual(candidate, snapshot)
+        self.assertEqual(r["classification"], "SYNTHETIC_ROLE_RELATION_ONLY")
+        for key in ("relation_attested", "actual_golden_pass", "strict_match", "ready"):
+            self.assertIs(r[key], False)
+        for flag in flags:
+            self.assertIn(flag, r["issues"])
+        return r
+
+    def test_01_baseline_shape_is_not_native_proof(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self.check(self.baseline())["issues"], [])
+
+    def test_02_declared_attack_no_deployed_attack(self):
+        g = self.baseline(); g["roster"].pop(0)
+        self.check(g, "DECLARED_WITHOUT_DEPLOYED_ATTACK")
+
+    def test_03_deployed_attack_no_declaration(self):
+        g = self.baseline(); g["sides"]["attack"] = []
+        self.check(g, "DEPLOYED_WITHOUT_DECLARED_ATTACK")
+
+    def test_04_declared_defense_no_deployed_defense(self):

+    def test_15_nonnative_raw_pointer_is_not_a_label(self):

+        r = self.check(g, "INVALID_SIDE_DECLARATION_ATTACK")

+    def test_16_blank_participant_is_not_empty_proof(self):

+        r = self.check(g, "INVALID_SIDE_DECLARATION_DEFENSE")
+        self.assertNotIn("DEPLOYED_WITHOUT_DECLARED_DEFENSE", r["issues"])
+
+    def test_17_duplicate_side_participant_requires_review(self):
+        g = self.baseline(); g["sides"]["attack"] = ["power-a", "power-a"]
+        self.check(g, "DUPLICATE_SIDE_DECLARATION_ATTACK")
+
+    def test_18_roster_not_array_of_objects(self):
+        g = self.baseline(); g["roster"].append("synthetic")
+        self.check(g, "ROSTER_ROW_UNTYPED")
+
+    def test_19_none_not_a_g2_object(self):
+        self.check(None, "G2_NOT_OBJECT")
+
+    def test_20_forged_observed_status_does_not_grant_native_proof(self):

+                                       actual_golden_pass=True, ready=True)
+        self.assertEqual(self.check(g)["issues"], [])
+
+    def test_21_empty_all_roles_and_roster_is_shape_only(self):
+        g = self.baseline(); g["sides"] = dict.fromkeys(ROLES, [])

+    def test_22_declaration_missing_is_not_an_observed_absence(self):

+from copy import deepcopy
+import unittest

+import t020_cnb02_receipt_provenance_gate_20261021_2345 as receipts

+SIDES = ("attack", "defense", "support")
+PARENT_REVIEW = {"SYNTHETIC_SCHEMA_ONLY", "ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW_NOT_MATCH"}
+PLACEHOLDERS = {"observed-map", "static_unconfirmed_map", "unknown", "placeholder"}
+
+
+def typed_label(v):
+    return isinstance(v, str) and bool(v.strip())
+
+
+def review_g2(receipt):
+    """Report suspicious shapes, not origin, actual deployment, or equivalence."""
+    parent = gate(receipt)
+    flags = set()
+    if parent not in PARENT_REVIEW:
+        return dict(parent=parent, flags=["PARENT_NOT_REVIEWABLE"],
+                    actual_golden_pass=False, strict_match=False)
+    g2 = receipt["stages"]["g2"]
+    map_id = g2.get("map_id")
+    if not typed_label(map_id) or map_id.strip().lower() in PLACEHOLDERS:
+        flags.add("MAP_ID_PLACEHOLDER_OR_INVALID")
+    # A hex digest here is not proof of the native loaded map's identity.
+    if not sha_ok(g2.get("map_capture_sha")):
+        flags.add("NATIVE_MAP_BYTES_UNVERIFIED")
+    else:
+        flags.add("MAP_HASH_FORMAT_ONLY_NOT_PROOF")
+    sides = g2["sides"]
+    for side in ("attack", "defense"):
+        if not sides[side]:
+            flags.add("EMPTY_" + side.upper() + "_SIDE")
+    for side in SIDES:
+        if any(not typed_label(label) for label in sides[side]):
+            flags.add("INVALID_SIDE_PARTICIPANT_LABEL")
+    seen = set()
+    represented = set()
+    for row in g2["roster"]:
+        side = row.get("side")
+        if not isinstance(side, str) or side not in SIDES:
+            flags.add("INVALID_ROSTER_SIDE")
+        else:
+            represented.add(side)
+        if not typed_label(row.get("unit_visible")):
+            flags.add("INVALID_UNIT_VISIBLE_ID")
+        if not typed_label(row.get("troop_visible")):
+            flags.add("INVALID_TROOP_VISIBLE_ID")
+        # Duplicate *visible labels* may denote distinct native instances.
+        if all(typed_label(row.get(k)) for k in ("unit_visible", "troop_visible")):
+            key = (side, row["unit_visible"], row["troop_visible"])
+            if key in seen:
+                flags.add("DUPLICATE_VISIBLE_PAIR_REVIEW")
+            seen.add(key)
+    for side in ("attack", "defense"):
+        if side not in represented:
+            flags.add("NO_" + side.upper() + "_ROSTER_RECEIPT")
+    # side lists may represent Powers, not Unit/Troop IDs; do NOT equate them.
+    # No native save/recording or deployed roster identity is authenticated here.
+    return dict(parent=parent, flags=sorted(flags),
+                actual_golden_pass=False, strict_match=False)
+
+

+FIELDS = ("mode2_enter", "active_enter", "active_zero", "mode1_return", "g2_capture")
+def assess(row):
+    if row.get("same_clock") is not True:
+        phase = "CLOCK_DOMAIN_VERIFY"
+    elif any(type(row.get(k)) not in (float, int) or
+             not math.isfinite(row[k]) for k in FIELDS):
+        phase = "TIME_EVIDENCE_INVALID"
+    else:
+        m, a, z, r, c = (row[k] for k in FIELDS)
+        if not (m <= a < z <= r):
+            phase = "PHASE_ORDER_INVALID"
+        elif c < m:
+            phase = "BEFORE_MODE2_NOT_G2"
+        elif c < a:
+            phase = "MODE2_PREACTIVE_VERIFY"
+        elif c < z:
+            phase = "ACTIVE_WINDOW_REVIEW_ONLY"
+        elif c < r:
+            phase = "ACTIVE_ZERO_EXIT_TAIL_NOT_G2"
+        else:
+            phase = "MODE1_POSTBATTLE_NOT_G2"
+    return {"phase": phase, "golden_pass": False, "strict_match": False}
+
+def baseline():
+    return dict(mode2_enter=10.0, active_enter=13.0,
+                active_zero=130.0, mode1_return=132.0,

+"""E/T020: archived pointer identity across observed mode epochs; NOT Golden."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+import pathlib
+import unittest
+
+BASE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "rea_lab/headless_analysis/search_index"
+PIN = {
+    "BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_23272_20261021T142710802580Z.jsonl":
+        ("9DF9A0D8C7D15958F4711478ED6DFF1F912E49313D6FC5BA5DCBC5B089E262A7", 234),
+    "BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_V2_23272_20261021T151336188087Z.jsonl":
+        ("1D60CC8CDC6D3B9F020FB52238C3A714F069EA4A4B489F874D90F41FEEE74B46", 85),
+}
+
+def summarize(name, expected_sha, expected_rows):
+    raw = (BASE / name).read_bytes()
+    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper() != expected_sha:
+        raise AssertionError("SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if line.strip()]
+    if len(rows) != expected_rows:
+        raise AssertionError("ROW_COUNT_MISMATCH")
+    states = [(r["utc"], r.get("state", r.get("initial", r.get("snapshot"))))
+              for r in rows]
+    states = [(t, s) for t, s in states if isinstance(s, dict)]
+    active = [(t, s) for t, s in states if s.get("mode") == 2 and s.get("active") == 1]
+    if not active:
+        raise AssertionError("NO_ACTIVE_SAMPLE")
+    first, last = active[0][0], active[-1][0]
+    active_ptrs = {s["battlefield_ptr"] for _, s in active}
+    if len(active_ptrs) != 1:
+        raise AssertionError("ACTIVE_POINTER_NOT_SINGLETON")
+    ptr = next(iter(active_ptrs))
+    strategy = lambda s: s.get("mode") == 1 and s.get("active") == 0
+    pre = [(t, s) for t, s in states if t < first and strategy(s)]
+    post = [(t, s) for t, s in states if t > last and strategy(s)]
+    changes = [(t, prev["battlefield_ptr"], cur["battlefield_ptr"], cur["mode"], cur["active"])
+               for (old_t, prev), (t, cur) in zip(states, states[1:])
+               if prev["battlefield_ptr"] != cur["battlefield_ptr"]]
+    result = {
+        "rows": len(rows), "active_ptr": ptr, "active_samples": len(active),
+        "pre_strategy": len(pre), "pre_same_ptr": sum(s["battlefield_ptr"] == ptr for _, s in pre),
+        "post_strategy": len(post), "post_same_ptr": sum(s["battlefield_ptr"] == ptr for _, s in post),
+        "pre_unique_ptrs": len({s["battlefield_ptr"] for _, s in pre}),
+        "pointer_changes": len(changes),
+        "changes_outside_pre_strategy": sum(t >= first or mode != 1 or on != 0
+                                            for t, old, new, mode, on in changes),
+        "first_pre_same_ptr_utc": next((t for t, s in pre if s["battlefield_ptr"] == ptr), None),
+        "verdict": "VERIFY_NOT_GOLDEN",
+    }
+    return result
+
+class EpochIdentityRegression(unittest.TestCase):
+    def source(self, index):
+        name, (sha, n) = list(PIN.items())[index]
+        return summarize(name, sha, n)
+

+
+    def test_identity_not_golden(self):

+            d = self.source(i)

+            self.assertGreater(d["pre_same_ptr"], 0)
+            self.assertEqual(d["post_strategy"], d["post_same_ptr"])

+    def test_reject_bad_source_sha(self):

+            summarize(name, "0" * 64, n)

+    def test_reject_bad_row_count(self):

+def inspect_one(filename, expected_hash, expected_rows):
+    raw = (ARCHIVE / filename).read_bytes()
+    actual = hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper()
+    if actual != expected_hash:
+        raise AssertionError("SOURCE_SHA_MISMATCH " + filename)
+    rows = [json.loads(s) for s in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if s.strip()]
+    if len(rows) != expected_rows:

+    states = []
+    for r in rows:

+        if not isinstance(v, dict):

+        ptr = v.get("battlefield_ptr", "0x0")
+        ptr = int(ptr, 16) if isinstance(ptr, str) else int(ptr)
+        states.append((r, v, ptr))
+    return rows, states
+

+                 if v.get("mode")==1 and v.get("active")==0]
+    active = [(r, v, ptr) for r,v,ptr in states
+              if v.get("mode")==2 and v.get("active")==1]

+        "state_rows": len(states),
+        "pointer_nonzero": sum(ptr!=0 for r,v,ptr in states),
+        "pointer_nonzero_strategic": sum(ptr!=0 for r,v,ptr in strategic),
+        "attack_positive_strategic": sum(v.get("attack_count",0)>0 for r,v,ptr in strategic),

+        "completed_packet_rows": sum(r.get("kind")=="CAPTURE_COMPLETE" for r in rows),
+        "capture_saved_final": next((r.get("captures_saved") for r in rows[::-1]
+                                    if "captures_saved" in r), None),
+    }

+"""E T020 C-NB02 receipt evidence shape; never asserts original gameplay PASS."""
+import re
+import unittest
+
+OLD_EXE = "E8DAC301050C8E630D7E0CE93AEEFD95E641207D9C0576017F62BA46A8767187"
+STAGES = ("g0", "g1", "g2", "g3", "g4")
+REQUIRED = ("old_save", "old_dat", "old_map", "old_input")
+HEX64 = re.compile(r"^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$")
+
+def sha_ok(value):
+    return isinstance(value, str) and HEX64.fullmatch(value) is not None
+
+def gate(r):
+    if r.get("eligible") is False:
+        return "INELIGIBLE"
+    if not r.get("old_observed"):
+        return "DESIGNED_NOT_RUN"
+    if r.get("source_class") != "ORIGINAL_UI" or r.get("old_exe_sha") != OLD_EXE:
+        return "REJECT_SOURCE"
+    if not all(sha_ok(r.get(k)) for k in REQUIRED):
+        return "REJECT_EVIDENCE"
+    stages = r.get("stages", {})
+    if not all(k in stages for k in STAGES):
+        return "VERIFY"
+    runs = {stages[k].get("run_id") for k in STAGES}
+    if None in runs or len(runs) != 1 or r.get("run_id") not in runs:
+        return "REJECT_EVIDENCE"
+    for k in STAGES:
+        s = stages[k]
+        if s.get("source_class") != "ORIGINAL_UI":
+            return "REJECT_SOURCE"
+        if not sha_ok(s.get("capture_sha")):
+            return "REJECT_EVIDENCE"
+        ts = s.get("t_ms")
+        if isinstance(ts, bool) or not isinstance(ts, (int, float)) or ts < 0:
+            return "REJECT_EVIDENCE"
+    t = {k: stages[k]["t_ms"] for k in STAGES}
+    # G0 UI entrance and G1 pre-battle SAVE may interleave; both precede deployment.
+    if not (t["g0"] < t["g2"] and t["g1"] < t["g2"] <= t["g3"] < t["g4"]):
+        return "REJECT_EVIDENCE"
+    g2 = stages["g2"]
+    if not g2.get("map_id") or not isinstance(g2.get("roster"), list) or not g2["roster"]:
+        return "VERIFY"
+    sides = g2.get("sides")
+    if not isinstance(sides, dict) or set(sides) != {"attack", "defense", "support"}:
+        return "VERIFY"
+    if any(not isinstance(sides[side], list) for side in sides):
+        return "VERIFY"
+    if any(not all(item.get(k) for k in ("side", "unit_visible", "troop_visible"))
+           for item in g2["roster"] if isinstance(item, dict)):
+        return "VERIFY"
+    if any(not isinstance(item, dict) for item in g2["roster"]):
+        return "VERIFY"
+    paths = r.get("commit_paths")
+    if isinstance(paths, list) and "native" in paths and "new_api" in paths:
+        return "REJECT_DOUBLE_COMMIT"
+    if paths not in (["native"], ["new_api"]):
+        return "VERIFY"
+    if not sha_ok(r.get("new_build_sha")) or not sha_ok(r.get("new_capture_sha")):
+        return "NO_STRICT_COMPARISON"
+    # Passing schema is never a gameplay observation or strict MATCH.
+    return "SYNTHETIC_SCHEMA_ONLY" if r.get("synthetic") else "ELIGIBLE_FOR_REVIEW_NOT_MATCH"
+

+"""E T020: retrospective observer-bracket classifier (synthetic timestamps only).
+Do NOT promote any classification to original Golden or engine event time.
+"""
+import copy
+import json
+import unittest
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from pathlib import Path
+
+FIXTURE = Path(__file__).with_name("T020_CNB02_WATCH1_SAMPLING_BOUNDS_20261025_19H.json")
+EXPECTED_SHA = "9DF9A0D8C7D15958F4711478ED6DFF1F912E49313D6FC5BA5DCBC5B089E262A7"
+BRACKET_KINDS = [("mode", 1, 2), ("active", 0, 1),
+                 ("active", 1, 0), ("mode", 2, 1)]
+
+def parse_utc(value):
+    if not isinstance(value, str):
+        raise ValueError("timestamp must be a string")
+    t = datetime.fromisoformat(value)
+    if t.tzinfo is None:
+        raise ValueError("unqualified clock")
+    return t.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+
+def classify(fixture, capture_utc, clock="UTC_WALL_OBSERVATION"):
+    verdict = {"phase": "VERIFY", "original_gameplay": False,
+               "actual_golden_pass": False, "strict_match": False,
+               "engine_transition_time_known": False}
+    source = fixture.get("source", {})
+    if source.get("sha256") != EXPECTED_SHA or source.get("record_count") != 234:
+        verdict["phase"] = "SOURCE_PROVENANCE_VERIFY"
+        return verdict
+    if clock != "UTC_WALL_OBSERVATION":
+        verdict["phase"] = "CLOCK_CALIBRATION_VERIFY"
+        return verdict
+    if capture_utc is None:
+        verdict["phase"] = "NO_ACTUAL_G2_CAPTURE"
+        return verdict
+    try:
+        cap = parse_utc(capture_utc)
+        brackets = fixture["brackets"]
+        assert len(brackets) == 4
+        assert [(b["field"], b["old"], b["new"]) for b in brackets] == BRACKET_KINDS
+        pairs = [(parse_utc(b["last_old"]), parse_utc(b["first_new"])) for b in brackets]
+        assert all(a < b for a, b in pairs)
+        assert all(pairs[i][1] <= pairs[i+1][0] for i in range(3))
+    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, AssertionError):
+        verdict["phase"] = "INVALID_OBSERVATION_BRACKETS"
+        return verdict
+    m0, m1 = pairs[0]
+    a0, a1 = pairs[1]
+    z0, z1 = pairs[2]
+    r0, r1 = pairs[3]
+    if cap <= m0: phase = "BEFORE_MODE2_NOT_G2"
+    elif cap < m1: phase = "PHASE_BOUNDARY_VERIFY"
+    elif cap <= a0: phase = "PREACTIVE_REVIEW_ONLY"
+    elif cap < a1: phase = "PHASE_BOUNDARY_VERIFY"

+"""E/T020 archived original watcher pointer phase audit; source read-only, not Golden."""
+import collections
+import hashlib
+import json
+import pathlib
+import unittest
+from datetime import datetime
+
+BASE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "rea_lab/headless_analysis/search_index"
+SOURCES = {
+    "BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_23272_20261021T142710802580Z.jsonl":
+        ("9DF9A0D8C7D15958F4711478ED6DFF1F912E49313D6FC5BA5DCBC5B089E262A7", 234),
+    "BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_V2_23272_20261021T151336188087Z.jsonl":
+        ("1D60CC8CDC6D3B9F020FB52238C3A714F069EA4A4B489F874D90F41FEEE74B46", 85),
+}
+
+def audit(name, pinned_hash, expected_rows):
+    raw = (BASE / name).read_bytes()
+    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper() == pinned_hash, "SOURCE_HASH_CHANGED"
+    rows = [json.loads(s) for s in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if s.strip()]
+    assert len(rows) == expected_rows, "ROW_COUNT_CHANGED"
+    samples = []
+    for row in rows:
+        state = row.get("state", row.get("initial", row.get("snapshot")))
+        if not isinstance(state, dict):
+            continue
+        ptr = state.get("battlefield_ptr", "0")
+        ptr = int(ptr, 16) if isinstance(ptr, str) else int(ptr)
+        samples.append((datetime.fromisoformat(row["utc"]), state, ptr, row.get("label"), row.get("kind")))
+    active = [t for t, st, ptr, label, kind in samples if st.get("mode") == 2 and st.get("active") == 1]
+    assert active, "NO_ACTIVE_OBSERVATION"
+    first, last = min(active), max(active)
+    counts = collections.Counter()
+    examples = {}
+    for t, st, ptr, label, kind in samples:
+        if st.get("mode") != 1 or st.get("active") != 0:
+            continue
+        phase = "BEFORE_FIRST_ACTIVE" if t < first else ("AFTER_LAST_ACTIVE" if t > last else "WITHIN_ACTIVE_SAMPLE_SPAN")
+        counts[phase + ":all_strategy"] += 1
+        if ptr:
+            counts[phase + ":ptr_nonzero"] += 1
+            examples.setdefault(phase, {"utc": t.isoformat(), "label": label, "kind": kind, "attack_count": st.get("attack_count")})
+        if st.get("attack_count", 0) > 0:
+            counts[phase + ":attack_positive"] += 1
+        if label == "PREPARED_WAR_MAP":
+            counts[phase + ":prepared_label"] += 1
+    return {"file": name, "sha256": pinned_hash, "rows": len(rows), "first_active_sample": first.isoformat(), "last_active_sample": last.isoformat(), "counts": dict(sorted(counts.items())), "pointer_examples": examples, "classification": "ARCHIVED_OBSERVATION_NOT_GOLDEN"}
+
+class ArchivedPointerLifecycle(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_two_source_byte_pins_and_independent_phases(self):
+        for name, (sha, rows) in SOURCES.items():
+            with self.subTest(name=name):
+                d = audit(name, sha, rows)
+                self.assertEqual(d["rows"], rows)
+                self.assertEqual(d["classification"], "ARCHIVED_OBSERVATION_NOT_GOLDEN")
+                self.assertGreater(sum(v for k,v in d["counts"].items() if k.endswith(":ptr_nonzero")), 0)
+                print("PREPOST_AUDIT", json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True))
+    def test_reject_wrong_source_hash(self):
+        name, (sha, rows) = next(iter(SOURCES.items()))
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, "SOURCE_HASH_CHANGED"):
+            audit(name, "0"*64, rows)
+    def test_reject_wrong_row_count(self):
+        name, (sha, rows) = next(iter(SOURCES.items()))
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(AssertionError, "ROW_COUNT_CHANGED"):
+            audit(name, sha, rows+1)
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

+# E/T020: read-only original-watch replay plus synthetic Golden eligibility negatives.
+import hashlib, json
+from collections import Counter
+from datetime import datetime
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+IDX = ROOT / "rea_lab" / "headless_analysis" / "search_index"
+FIXTURE = Path(__file__).with_name("T020_DUAL_WATCH_FAILURE_EPOCH_CASES_20261024_0951.json")
+WATCHES = [
+ ("BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_23272_20261021T142710802580Z.jsonl",
+  "9DF9A0D8C7D15958F4711478ED6DFF1F912E49313D6FC5BA5DCBC5B089E262A7", 234,
+  "SnapshotError", "unexpected nil tree node", 116.56, 12.372),
+ ("BATTLE_ORIGINAL_WATCH_V2_23272_20261021T151336188087Z.jsonl",
+  "1D60CC8CDC6D3B9F020FB52238C3A714F069EA4A4B489F874D90F41FEEE74B46", 85,
+  "ValueError", "Unbounded memory request", 163.92, 11.445),
+]
+def stamp(s):
+    return datetime.fromisoformat(s)
+def audit(filename, sha, n, error_type, reason, active_s, attempt_s):
+    data = (IDX / filename).read_bytes()
+    assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest().upper() == sha
+    rows = [json.loads(x) for x in data.decode("utf-8").splitlines() if x.strip()]
+    assert len(rows) == n
+    changes = [r for r in rows if r["kind"] == "STATE_CHANGE"]
+    start = next(r for r in changes if r["state"]["mode"] == 2 and r["state"]["active"] == 1)
+    end = next(r for r in changes if r["state"]["mode"] == 2 and r["state"]["active"] == 0 and stamp(r["utc"]) > stamp(start["utc"]))
+    gaps = [r for r in rows if r["kind"] == "CAPTURE_VERIFY_GAP"]
+    assert len(gaps) == 28 and [g["attempt"] for g in gaps] == list(range(1,29))
+    assert all(g["error_type"] == error_type and g["reason"] == reason for g in gaps)
+    run_s = (stamp(end["utc"]) - stamp(start["utc"])).total_seconds()
+    window_s = (stamp(gaps[-1]["utc"]) - stamp(gaps[0]["utc"])).total_seconds()
+    assert abs(run_s-active_s) < 0.02 and abs(window_s-attempt_s) < 0.02
+    assert all(stamp(start["utc"]) <= stamp(g["utc"]) <= stamp(end["utc"]) for g in gaps)
+    assert (stamp(gaps[-1]["utc"]) - stamp(start["utc"])).total_seconds() < 15
+    assert not any(r["kind"] in ("CAPTURE_SUCCESS","COMPLETE_PACKET","G2_ROSTER_CAPTURED") for r in rows)
+    return {"rows":len(rows), "errors":dict(Counter(g["error_type"]+"/"+g["reason"] for g in gaps)),
+            "active_seconds":round(run_s,3), "attempt_seconds":round(window_s,3),
+            "late_capture_attempts":sum(stamp(g["utc"]) > stamp(start["utc"]) and
+                (stamp(g["utc"])-stamp(start["utc"])).total_seconds() > 15 for g in gaps),
+            "native_packet_success_records":0}
+def classify(c):
+    if c.get("native_crash_claim"): return "REJECT_NATIVE_BUG_ASSERTION"
+    if c.get("same_pid_cross_run"): return "REJECT_RUN_IDENTITY"
+    if c.get("late_retry_claim"): return "REJECT_UNOBSERVED_RETRY"
+    if c.get("source_hash_valid") is False: return "REJECT_PROVENANCE"
+    if not c.get("packet"): return "NO_COMPLETE_PACKET"
+    if not all(c.get(k) for k in ("legal_ui","presave","inputs","map","three_sides","ordered_roster")):
+        return "GOLDEN_NOT_ELIGIBLE"
+    return "ELIGIBLE_CAPTURE_REVIEW"
+def main():
+    results = [audit(*w) for w in WATCHES]
+    cases = json.loads(FIXTURE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["cases"]
+    ids = [c["id"] for c in cases]
+    assert len(ids) == len(set(ids))
+    for c in cases:
+        got = classify(c)
+        assert got == c["expected"], f'{c["id"]}: {got} != {c["expected"]}'
+    print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS", "watch_replays":len(results),
+        "cases_passed":len(cases), "watch_results":results,
+        "old_game_executed":False, "actual_golden_pass":0, "strict_match":0},
+        ensure_ascii=True))
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+"""E/T020 E10->E11->E12 strict synthetic-preflight erratum.
+
+Reuses existing 2026-10-28 10H/11H/12H E study IDs; adds no native evidence.
+A True preflight is ELIGIBILITY_ONLY, never original Golden/MATCH/READY.
+This script is pure Python: no original EXE/DAT/SAVE/MAP or V9 dependency.
+"""
+import unittest
+
+FLAGS = ("g0", "g1", "g2", "same_run", "original_dat", "actual_execution")
+
+
+def strict_eligible(receipts):
+    """Reject missing/extra/implicit-truthy flags; does not authenticate any receipt."""
+    return (type(receipts) is dict and set(receipts) == set(FLAGS)
+            and all(type(receipts[k]) is bool and receipts[k] is True for k in FLAGS))
+
+
+def strict_verdict(receipts, old_capture=None, new_capture=None):
+    """Never produces PASS/READY. Actual source/identity/byte checks are external."""
+    if not strict_eligible(receipts):
+        return "NOT_ELIGIBLE"
+    if old_capture is None:
+        return "NO_ACTUAL_GOLDEN"
+    if new_capture is None:
+        return "NO_STRICT_COMPARISON"
+    return "COMPARE_REQUIRED"
+
+
+class StrictAdmissionErratumTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def valid(self):
+        return dict.fromkeys(FLAGS, True)
+
+    def test_literal_true_only_eligible_not_pass(self):
+        self.assertTrue(strict_eligible(self.valid()))
+        self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(self.valid()), "NO_ACTUAL_GOLDEN")
+
+    def test_each_false_rejected(self):
+        for key in FLAGS:
+            with self.subTest(key=key):
+                x = self.valid(); x[key] = False
+                self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(x), "NOT_ELIGIBLE")
+
+    def test_each_truthy_false_string_rejected(self):
+        for key in FLAGS:
+            with self.subTest(key=key):
+                x = self.valid(); x[key] = "false"
+                self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(x, {}, {}), "NOT_ELIGIBLE")
+
+    def test_each_integer_one_rejected(self):
+        for key in FLAGS:
+            with self.subTest(key=key):
+                x = self.valid(); x[key] = 1
+                self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(x, {}, {}), "NOT_ELIGIBLE")
+
+    def test_other_truthy_placeholders_rejected(self):
+        for value in ("0", "true", 2, [], [1], {"proof": True}, None):
+            with self.subTest(value=repr(value)):
+                x = self.valid(); x["g2"] = value
+                self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(x, {}, {}), "NOT_ELIGIBLE")
+
+    def test_partial_and_unknown_keys_rejected(self):
+        x = self.valid(); del x["same_run"]
+        self.assertFalse(strict_eligible(x))
+        x = self.valid(); x["synthetic_fixture_pass"] = True
+        self.assertFalse(strict_eligible(x))
+
+    def test_non_dict_rejected(self):
+        for x in (None, [], "true", True):
+            with self.subTest(value=repr(x)):
+                self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(x), "NOT_ELIGIBLE")
+
+    def test_old_capture_alone_not_match(self):
+        self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(self.valid(), {"old": 1}), "NO_STRICT_COMPARISON")
+
+    def test_two_captures_only_comparison_required(self):
+        self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(self.valid(), {"old": 1}, {"new": 1}),
+                         "COMPARE_REQUIRED")
+
+    def test_boolean_flags_do_not_authenticate_real_same_run(self):
+        # Caller-provided bools can lie. This is a *synthetic classifier* only.
+        x = self.valid()
+        self.assertTrue(strict_eligible(x))
+        self.assertNotIn(strict_verdict(x, {}, {}), ("PASS", "READY", "STRICT_MATCH"))
+
+    def test_previous_e10_truthiness_bug_reproducer(self):
+        # The archived E10 source uses all((g0,g1,g2,same_run,original_dat,actual_execution)).
+        x = dict.fromkeys(FLAGS, "false")
+        self.assertTrue(all(x[k] for k in FLAGS))
+        self.assertFalse(strict_eligible(x))
+
+    def test_invalid_flags_never_compare_even_with_captures(self):
+        x = self.valid(); x["actual_execution"] = 1
+        self.assertEqual(strict_verdict(x, {"old": 1}, {"new": 1}), "NOT_ELIGIBLE")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

+"""E T018/T020: E21 artifact-byte attestation vs native Golden proof."""
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import re
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+import t020_e21_g2_schema_bridge_gate_20261028_22H as old
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+DATA = json.loads((HERE / "T020_E21_SOURCE_ATTESTATION_CASES_20261028_23H.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+BRIDGE = json.loads((HERE / "T020_E21_G2_SCHEMA_BRIDGE_CASES_20261028_22H.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+
+def source_pin(expected, raw=None):
+    if not isinstance(expected, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{64}", expected):
+        return "MALFORMED_SOURCE_SHA"
+    if raw is None:
+        return "SOURCE_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE"
+    if not isinstance(raw, bytes):
+        return "SOURCE_BYTES_INVALID_TYPE"
+    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().lower() != expected.lower():
+        return "SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH"
+    return "SYNTHETIC_ARTIFACT_BYTE_IDENTITY_ONLY"
+
+def audit(receipt, raw=None):
+    flags = set(old.bridge(receipt)["issues"])
+    source_status = source_pin(BRIDGE["source_e21_fixture_sha256"], raw)
+    flags.add(source_status)
+    if not isinstance(receipt, dict) or receipt.get("capture_source") != "SYNTHETIC":
+        flags.add("CAPTURE_SOURCE_UNTRUSTED")
+    g2 = receipt.get("g2") if isinstance(receipt, dict) else None
+    if not isinstance(g2, dict) or not isinstance(g2.get("map_sha"), str):
+        flags.add("MAP_SHA_ABSENT_OR_UNTYPED")
+    else:
+        flags.add("MAP_SHA_NOT_NATIVE_MAP_BYTES")
+    flags.add("ORIGINAL_EXE_SHA_MANIFEST_NOT_RUNTIME_PROOF")
+    flags.add("G0_G1_G2_LEGAL_WITNESS_NOT_ATTACHED")
+    return {"status": "VERIFY_NOT_GOLDEN", "flags": sorted(flags),
+            "source_attestation": source_status, "actual_golden_pass": False,
+            "strict_match": False}
+
+class ArtifactAttestationTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_01_source_id_matches_e22_pin(self):
+        self.assertEqual(BRIDGE["source_e21_fixture_sha256"], DATA["chat_artifact_sha256"])
+    def test_02_source_not_present_on_pc(self):
+        self.assertEqual(audit(BRIDGE["capture"])["source_attestation"], "SOURCE_BYTES_UNAVAILABLE")
+    def test_03_malformed_hex_sha(self):
+        self.assertEqual(source_pin("z"*64,b"a"), "MALFORMED_SOURCE_SHA")
+    def test_04_non64_sha(self):
+        self.assertEqual(source_pin("0"*63,b"a"), "MALFORMED_SOURCE_SHA")
+    def test_05_bad_data_type(self):
+        self.assertEqual(source_pin("0"*64, "not-bytes"), "SOURCE_BYTES_INVALID_TYPE")

+def _unique_object(pairs):
+    result = {}
+    for key, value in pairs:
+        if key in result:
+            raise ValueError("duplicate JSON key")
+        result[key] = value
+    return result

+    raise ValueError("nonfinite JSON value")

+def _finite_float(token):
+    """Preserve JSON decimal precision while rejecting overflow and underflow.
+
+    Converting straight to float conflates e.g. 0.10000000000000001 and 0.1.
+    The receipt can only attest the scalar it actually contains.
+    """
+    try:
+        exact = Decimal(token)
+        approximate = float(exact)
+    except (InvalidOperation, OverflowError, ValueError) as exc:
+        raise ValueError("invalid JSON decimal") from exc
+    if not math.isfinite(approximate) or (approximate == 0.0 and exact != 0):
+        raise ValueError("nonfinite or underflowing JSON decimal")
+    return exact
+

+def _typed_equal(a, b):
+    """Recursive JSON-value equality with strict bool/int/decimal boundaries.
+
+    A parsed JSON decimal retains its exact value; a supplied Python float
+    receipt is compared to its shortest round-trip decimal representation.
+    This deliberately rejects extra precision absent from the receipt.
+    """
+    if type(a) is Decimal:
+        return (type(b) is float and math.isfinite(b) and
+                a == Decimal(str(b)) and
+                (not a.is_zero() or a.is_signed() == (math.copysign(1.0, b) < 0)))
+    if type(a) is not type(b):
+        return False
+    if isinstance(a, dict):
+        return (a.keys() == b.keys() and
+                all(_typed_equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a))
+    if isinstance(a, list):
+        return len(a) == len(b) and all(_typed_equal(x, y)
+                                        for x, y in zip(a, b))
+    return a == b

+def strict_equal(a, b):
+    if type(a) is not type(b):
+        return False
+    if isinstance(a, dict):
+        return a.keys() == b.keys() and all(strict_equal(a[k], b[k]) for k in a)
+    if isinstance(a, list):
+        return len(a) == len(b) and all(strict_equal(x, y) for x, y in zip(a, b))
+    return a == b
+
+def reject_nonstandard(value):
+    raise ValueError("NONSTANDARD_JSON_NUMBER:" + value)
+
+def schema_check(projected):
+    g2 = projected["g2"]
+    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9A-Fa-f]{64}", g2["map_sha"]):
+        return False
+    for side in g2["sides"]:
+        if not isinstance(side, dict):
+            return False
+        for key in ("role", "id"):
+            if type(side.get(key)) is not str or not side[key].strip():
+                return False
+    for row in g2["deployed"]:
+        if not isinstance(row, dict):
+            return False
+        for key in ("order", "x", "y"):
+            if type(row.get(key)) is not int:
+                return False
+        if row["order"] < 0:
+            return False
+        for key in ("side_id", "troop", "unit"):
+            if type(row.get(key)) is not str or not row[key].strip():
+                return False
+    return True
+
+def strict_bind(receipt, source_bytes, expected_hash):
+    status, expected = prior.projection(source_bytes, expected_hash)
+    if expected is None:
+        return status
+    try:
+        json.loads(source_bytes.decode("utf-8"),
+                   object_pairs_hook=prior._no_duplicates,
+                   parse_constant=reject_nonstandard)
+    except (ValueError, TypeError, UnicodeError):
+        return "SOURCE_JSON_NONSTANDARD_OR_INVALID"
+    if not schema_check(expected):
+        return "SOURCE_G2_FIELDS_INVALID"
+    if not strict_equal(receipt, expected):
+        return "SOURCE_TO_RECEIPT_TYPED_MISMATCH"
+    return "SYNTHETIC_TYPED_PROJECTION_BOUND_NOT_NATIVE"

+    for source in sources:
+        raw = source.read_bytes()
+        obj = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))

+
+def valid_hash(value):
+    return type(value) is str and HEX64.fullmatch(value) is not None
+
+def classify(expected, actual):
+    if not valid_hash(expected):
+        return "INVALID_PIN"
+    if actual is None:
+        return "MISSING"
+    if not valid_hash(actual):
+        return "INVALID_ACTUAL"
+    return "MATCH" if expected.lower() == actual.lower() else "DRIFT"
+
+def safe_relative(value):
+    if type(value) is not str or not value:
+        return False
+    path = Path(value)
+    return (not path.is_absolute() and
+            not any(x in ("", ".", "..") for x in path.parts) and
+            path.suffix.lower() == ".dat")
+
+def epoch_admission(capture_sha, current_sha, process_load_proven):
+    if not valid_hash(capture_sha) or not valid_hash(current_sha):
+        return "INVALID_SOURCE_PIN"
+    if capture_sha.lower() != current_sha.lower():
+        return "SOURCE_EPOCH_MISMATCH"
+    if process_load_proven is not True:
+        return "PROCESS_LOAD_EPOCH_UNVERIFIED"
+    return "SOURCE_EPOCH_STATIC_PIN_ONLY_NOT_GOLDEN"

+"""Read-only E/T020 audit: compare 2026-10-28 Library-pinned bytes against PC staging."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+TESTS = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

+        p = folder / row['name']
+        if not p.is_file():
+            out['missing'].append(row['name'])
+            continue
+        h = hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper()
+        out['match' if h == row['sha256'] and p.stat().st_size == row['bytes'] else 'hash_mismatch'].append(row['name'])
+    return out

+               and any(isinstance(t, ast.Name) and t.id == "EVIDENCE"
+                       for t in n.targets)]
+    if len(assigns) != 1 or not isinstance(assigns[0].value, ast.Constant):
+        raise AssertionError("runner EVIDENCE declaration changed")
+    if assigns[0].value.value != MARKER:
+        raise AssertionError("runner evidence kind changed")
+    funcs = [n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef)
+             and n.name == "run_fixture"]
+    if len(funcs) != 1:

+    dicts = [n for n in ast.walk(funcs[0]) if isinstance(n, ast.Call)
+             and isinstance(n.func, ast.Name) and n.func.id == "dict"]
+    required = {"playable": False, "original_gameplay_golden": 0,
+                "strict_match": 0}
+    valid = False
+    for call in dicts:
+        keyed = {kw.arg: kw.value for kw in call.keywords}
+        if all(k in keyed and isinstance(keyed[k], ast.Constant)
+               and type(keyed[k].value) is type(v) and keyed[k].value == v
+               for k, v in required.items()):
+            valid = True
+    if not valid:
+        raise AssertionError("runner provenance output schema changed")
+    if 'return 3 if result.get("execution_status")=="VERIFY" else 0' not in src:
+        raise AssertionError("CLI VERIFY return policy changed")
+    if 'return 2' not in src:
+        raise AssertionError("CLI blocked return policy changed")
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

+def classify(row):
+    if type(row) is not dict:
+        return "INVALID_RECORD"
+    if row.get("evidence") != MARKER:

+    if (type(row.get("strict_match")) is not int
+            or type(row.get("original_gameplay_golden")) is not int

+            or row["playable"] is not False):

+    if any(row.get(k) not in (None, False, 0)

+        return "SYNTHETIC_SELF_PROMOTION_REJECTED"
+    if row.get("execution_status") not in (
+            None, "VERIFY", "ENDED_BY_RESOLVED_INPUT"):
+        return "UNKNOWN_EXECUTION_STATUS"

+            or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-fA-F]{64}", row["map_sha256"])):
+        return "INVALID_MAP_DIGEST"

+from pathlib import Path

+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+STAGE = ROOT / "E_OFFLINE_SYNC_20261029"
+PC_MAN = ROOT / "T020_E_PC_20261025_27_BYTE_INVENTORY_20261029_05H.json"
+LIB_MAN = STAGE / "T020_E_LIBRARY_SOURCE_MANIFEST_20261029_04H.json"
+MANIFEST_PINS = {
+    "pc": "29DF7E435A3C63C0A33F7A2F38D83C2EA604E1791F669BAED5A38CF8BDC0DFE1",
+    "library": "10AB86C458598FEF0C81AEF2CC7118485950ACC57972D0B5C1B8031E637A37AC",
+}
+NAME21 = "T020_GOLDEN_CAPTURE_SEMANTIC_BIND_CASES_20261028_2149.json"
+ALIAS21 = NAME21.replace(".json", "_LIBPIN_7D574F25.json")
+
+def digest(raw):
+    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper()
+
+def rows_for(source):
+    manifest = PC_MAN if source == "pc" else LIB_MAN
+    raw = manifest.read_bytes()
+    if digest(raw) != MANIFEST_PINS[source]:
+        raise ValueError("MANIFEST_BYTE_MISMATCH")
+    doc = json.loads(raw)
+    rows = doc["items"]
+    expected = 133 if source == "pc" else 23
+    if len(rows) != expected:
+        raise ValueError("MANIFEST_CARDINALITY")
+    return rows
+
+def resolve(source, name):
+    """Return verified bytes, never 'native' or 'Golden accepted'."""
+    if source not in MANIFEST_PINS or not isinstance(name, str):
+        raise ValueError("SOURCE_OR_TYPE_INVALID")
+    if not name or name != Path(name).name or "/" in name or "\\" in name:
+        raise ValueError("UNTRUSTED_NAME")
+    rows = rows_for(source)
+    key = "file" if source == "pc" else "name"
+    matches = [x for x in rows if x[key] == name]
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        raise ValueError("NOT_PINNED_OR_AMBIGUOUS")
+    row = matches[0]
+    effective_name = ALIAS21 if source == "library" and name == NAME21 else name
+    root = ROOT if source == "pc" else STAGE
+    full = root / effective_name
+    if full.is_symlink() or not full.is_file():
+        raise ValueError("MISSING_OR_SYMLINK")
+    content = full.read_bytes()
+    if len(content) != row["bytes"] or digest(content) != row["sha256"]:
+        raise ValueError("SOURCE_BYTE_MISMATCH")
+    return {"status": "SOURCE_PINNED_STATIC_ONLY_NOT_NATIVE",
+            "path": str(full), "sha256": digest(content),
+            "bytes": content}
+
+def reject_unpinned_stale_copy():
+    row = next(x for x in rows_for("library") if x["name"] == NAME21)
+    stale = STAGE / NAME21
+    raw = stale.read_bytes()
+    return (len(raw) != row["bytes"] or digest(raw) != row["sha256"])

+# claimed reachable branch from the legal high-level training loop.
+def model(existing_key, incoming_key, old_bonus, proposed_bonus, base):
+    assert 0 <= existing_key <= 0xffffffff
+    assert 0 <= incoming_key <= 0xffffffff
+    cache = {existing_key: old_bonus}
+    duplicate = incoming_key in cache
+    if not duplicate: cache[incoming_key] = proposed_bonus
+    return {'insert_flag': 0 if duplicate else 1,
+            'incoming_discarded': duplicate, 'computed_current': base+proposed_bonus,
+            'cached_after': cache[incoming_key], 'next_same_leader': base+cache[incoming_key],
+            'node_count_after': len(cache), 'kind': 'DUPLICATE_INJECTED' if duplicate else 'DISTINCT_KEY_ASSUMED'}

+new_values = (-3,0,9)

+def evaluate(s):
+    if s.get("claim") == "actual_golden": return ["NOT_GAMEPLAY_PROOF", 0, 0, []]
+    if s.get("full_range") is not True: return ["PARTIAL_RANGE_UNMODELED", 0, 0, []]
+    nodes, root, count = s.get("nodes"), s.get("root"), s.get("count")
+    if type(count) is not int or count < 0: return ["REJECT_COUNT", 0, 0, []]
+    if type(nodes) is not dict: return ["REJECT_STRUCTURE", 0, 0, []]
+    if len(nodes) != count: return ["REJECT_COUNT", 0, 0, []]
+    if root is None and count == 0: return ["STATIC_FULL_RESET", 0, 0, []]
+    if type(root) is not str or root not in nodes: return ["REJECT_STRUCTURE", 0, 0, []]
+    seen, freed, heaps = set(), [], []
+    def visit(k):
+        if k is None: return
+        if type(k) is not str or k not in nodes or k in seen: raise ValueError("alias/cycle/missing")
+        seen.add(k)
+        n = nodes[k]
+        if type(n) is not dict or n.get("nil_flag", 0) != 0: raise ValueError("nil node")
+        cap = n.get("capacity")
+        if type(cap) is not int or cap < 0: raise ValueError("capacity")
+        visit(n.get("branch8"))
+        if cap >= 16: heaps.append(k)
+        freed.append(k)
+        visit(n.get("branch0"))
+    try:
+        visit(root)
+        if len(seen) != len(nodes): raise ValueError("orphan")
+    except (ValueError, TypeError, RecursionError):
+        return ["REJECT_STRUCTURE", 0, 0, []]
+    return ["STATIC_FULL_RESET", len(heaps), len(freed), freed]
+def main():
+    for name, sha in PIN.items():
+        assert hashlib.sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper() == sha, "SOURCE_PIN_MISMATCH: " + name
+    d = json.loads(CASE.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    assert (d["owner"], d["source_owner"], d["source_status"]) == ("E", "B", "VERIFY_NOT_READY")
+    assert d["origin"] == "SYNTHETIC_STATIC_CALL_PATH" and d["golden"] == [0,0,0]
+    rows = d["cases"]
+    assert len(rows) == 30 and len({r["id"] for r in rows}) == 30
+    for row in rows:
+        actual = evaluate(row["input"])
+        assert actual == row["expected"], f"{row['id']}: {actual} != {row['expected']}"
+    print(f"SOURCE_PINS {len(PIN)}/{len(PIN)} PASS")
+    print(f"FULL_TREE_SYNTHETIC {len(rows)}/{len(rows)} PASS")
+    print("ORIGINAL_GAMEPLAY=NOT_RUN ACTUAL_GOLDEN=0 STRICT_MATCH=0 B03H=NOT_READY")
+if __name__ == "__main__": main()

+"""E T020: flag0/flag1 source-bound acceptance, SYNTHETIC ONLY."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib
+import json
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+CASES = ROOT / "tests/T020_E_T028_VECTOR_HELPER_MODE_CASES_20261030_00H.json"
+PINS = {
+    ROOT / "data/T028_SPOT_VECTOR_HELPER_FLAG_SPLIT_NATIVE_20261030_00H.md":
+        "6F972CFB462306B9DF4620768E3C212E391A4153D6110F5F5F6EEC30DD53C9C6",
+    ROOT / "tests/t020_e_t028_reservation_count_release_gate_20261029_23H.py":
+        "BB1E4F17986D6065D1AE0E39A621E7302734AFE6A20DB476B8BB4AB46ABE34A4",
+}
+SITE_MODE = {"0x495544": 0, "0x495079": 0, "0x5AC5E7": 1}
+
+def classify(case):
+    site, mode = case.get("site"), case.get("mode")
+    if site not in SITE_MODE:
+        return "UNPROVEN_CALL_SITE"
+    if mode is None:
+        return "MISSING_MODE"
+    if type(mode) is not int or mode not in (0, 1):
+        return "INVALID_MODE"
+    if mode != SITE_MODE[site]:
+        return "SITE_MODE_CONFLICT"
+    if case.get("claim", "BRANCH_ONLY") != "BRANCH_ONLY":
+        return "UNSUPPORTED_BEHAVIOR_CLAIM"
+    length = case.get("vector_length")
+    if length is None:
+        return "UNKNOWN_VECTOR_LENGTH"
+    if type(length) is not int or length < 0:
+        return "INVALID_VECTOR_LENGTH"
+    if site == "0x5AC5E7":
+        return "CFG_REACH_UNVERIFIED"
+    return "FLAG0_EXTRA_BRANCHES_BYPASSED_COMMON_CALLS_UNRESOLVED"
+
+def main():
+    for path, expected in PINS.items():
+        assert hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper() == expected, f"SOURCE_CHANGED: {path}"
+    data = json.loads(CASES.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
+    assert data["owner"] == "E" and data["source_owner"] == "B"
+    assert data["source_status"] == "VERIFY_NOT_READY" and data["origin"] == "SYNTHETIC_STATIC_ONLY"
+    assert data["original_gameplay_dynamic_observed"] == 0
+    assert data["actual_golden_pass"] == data["strict_match"] == 0
+    rows = data["cases"]
+    assert len(rows) == 18 and len(set(x["id"] for x in rows)) == 18
+    for row in rows:
+        verdict = classify(row["input"])
+        assert verdict == row["expected"], f'{row["id"]}: {verdict} != {row["expected"]}'
+    print(f"SOURCE_PINS {len(PINS)}/{len(PINS)} PASS")
+    print(f"MODE_PROVENANCE_SYNTHETIC {len(rows)}/{len(rows)} PASS")
+    print("ORIGINAL_GAMEPLAY=NOT_RUN GOLDEN=0 STRICT_MATCH=0 B00H=NOT_READY")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+import importlib.util
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+PRIOR = HERE / "t020_e_v9_source_epoch_gate_20261029_14H.py"
+SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("e_prior_v9_gate_14h", PRIOR)
+prior = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
+SPEC.loader.exec_module(prior)

+EXPECTED_DB = "search_index/HAKUSHIN067_UNIFIED_V9_20261023.sqlite"
+EXPECTED_CLI = "search_index/search_unified_v9_20261023.py"
+
+def literal_bound(pointer, manifest, db_sha, cli_sha):
+    """Pin exact relative references as well as already-validated bytes/EXE."""
+    if not isinstance(pointer, dict):
+        return False
+    if type(pointer.get("current_database")) is not str:
+        return False
+    if type(pointer.get("current_cli")) is not str:
+        return False
+    if pointer["current_database"] != EXPECTED_DB:
+        return False
+    if pointer["current_cli"] != EXPECTED_CLI:
+        return False
+    if pointer.get("gameplay_result") != "STATIC_ONLY":
+        return False
+    return prior.admission(pointer, manifest, db_sha, cli_sha)
+
+class PointerPathBindingTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.p = copy.deepcopy(prior.PTR)
+        self.m = prior.MAN
+        self.db = prior.DB_HASH
+        self.cli = prior.CLI_HASH
+
+    def test_01_canonical_pointer_passes_static_only(self):
+        self.assertTrue(literal_bound(self.p, self.m, self.db, self.cli))
+    def test_02_prior_accepts_wrong_database_directory(self):
+        self.p["current_database"] = "other/" + Path(EXPECTED_DB).name
+        self.assertTrue(prior.admission(self.p, self.m, self.db, self.cli))
+    def test_03_new_rejects_wrong_database_directory(self):
+        self.p["current_database"] = "other/" + Path(EXPECTED_DB).name
+        self.assertFalse(literal_bound(self.p, self.m, self.db, self.cli))
+    def test_04_prior_accepts_wrong_cli_directory(self):
+        self.p["current_cli"] = "other/" + Path(EXPECTED_CLI).name
+        self.assertTrue(prior.admission(self.p, self.m, self.db, self.cli))
+    def test_05_new_rejects_wrong_cli_directory(self):
+        self.p["current_cli"] = "other/" + Path(EXPECTED_CLI).name
+        self.assertFalse(literal_bound(self.p, self.m, self.db, self.cli))
+    def test_06_new_rejects_parent_navigation(self):
+        self.p["current_database"] = "search_index/../other/" + Path(EXPECTED_DB).name
+        self.assertFalse(literal_bound(self.p, self.m, self.db, self.cli))
+    def test_07_new_rejects_absolute_path(self):

+        self.assertFalse(literal_bound(self.p, self.m, self.db, "0"*64))
+    def test_10_new_rejects_wrong_exe_source(self):

+    def test_11_new_rejects_missing_path(self):

+    def test_12_new_rejects_nonstring_path(self):

+"""E-only STATIC V9 source provenance test; no original game execution."""
+import copy
+import hashlib
+import json
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+IDX = ROOT / 'rea_lab' / 'headless_analysis' / 'search_index'
+ACTIVE = ROOT / 'rea_lab' / 'headless_analysis' / 'CURRENT_ACTIVE_RESEARCH_STATE_LATEST.json'
+V9 = 'HAKUSHIN067_UNIFIED_V9_20261023.sqlite'
+CLI = 'search_unified_v9_20261023.py'
+EXE = 'E8DAC301050C8E630D7E0CE93AEEFD95E641207D9C0576017F62BA46A8767187'
+
+def sha(path):
+    h = hashlib.sha256()
+    with path.open('rb') as f:
+        for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(1048576), b''):
+            h.update(chunk)
+    return h.hexdigest().upper()
+
+def admission(ptr, manifest, db_sha, cli_sha):
+    return (ptr.get('status') == 'CURRENT_V9_SELECTED_BY_USER_20261029'
+        and Path(ptr.get('current_database', '')).name == V9
+        and Path(ptr.get('current_cli', '')).name == CLI
+        and ptr.get('current_database_sha256') == manifest.get('db_sha256') == db_sha
+        and manifest.get('cli_sha256') == cli_sha
+        and ptr.get('exe_sha256') == manifest.get('source_provenance', {}).get('hakushin067_Vahren.exe') == EXE)
+
+PTR = json.loads(ACTIVE.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
+MAN = json.loads((IDX / 'UNIFIED_V9_INTEGRITY_20261023.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
+DB_HASH, CLI_HASH = sha(IDX / V9), sha(IDX / CLI)
+
+class V9SourceGate(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_01_real_v9_source_pin(self):
+        self.assertTrue(admission(PTR, MAN, DB_HASH, CLI_HASH))
+    def test_02_function_count(self):
+        self.assertEqual(MAN['counts']['functions'], 11950)
+    def test_03_ref_count(self):
+        self.assertEqual(MAN['counts']['ghidra_refs'], 243678)
+    def test_04_native_e8_jmp_not_same_count(self):
+        self.assertEqual(MAN['counts']['native_callsite'], 51214)
+        self.assertNotEqual(51214, 44890)
+    def test_05_old_pointer_rejected(self):
+        old = copy.deepcopy(PTR)
+        old['status'] = 'CURRENT_V3'
+        self.assertFalse(admission(old, MAN, DB_HASH, CLI_HASH))
+    def test_06_wrong_db_rejected(self):
+        self.assertFalse(admission(PTR, MAN, '0' * 64, CLI_HASH))
+    def test_07_wrong_cli_rejected(self):
+        self.assertFalse(admission(PTR, MAN, DB_HASH, '0' * 64))
+    def test_08_wrong_exe_rejected(self):
+        bad = copy.deepcopy(PTR)
+        bad['exe_sha256'] = '0' * 64
+        self.assertFalse(admission(bad, MAN, DB_HASH, CLI_HASH))
+    def test_09_golden_not_promoted(self):
+        self.assertEqual(PTR['gameplay_result'], 'STATIC_ONLY')
+    def test_10_prior_v9_doc_is_historical_not_pointer(self):
+        self.assertEqual(PTR['previous_pointer'].split(' ')[0], 'V3')
+        self.assertTrue(admission(PTR, MAN, DB_HASH, CLI_HASH))
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

+import pefile
+from capstone import Cs, CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32
+

+EXE = ROOT / "rea_lab" / "targets" / "hakushin067_Vahren.exe"
+FIX = Path(__file__).with_name("T020_FASTSIM_CLEANUP_NEGATIVES_20261023_2252.json")
+SHA = "E8DAC301050C8E630D7E0CE93AEEFD95E641207D9C0576017F62BA46A8767187"
+raw = EXE.read_bytes()
+assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest().upper() == SHA, "source EXE mismatch"
+pe = pefile.PE(data=raw, fast_load=True)
+cs = Cs(CS_ARCH_X86, CS_MODE_32)
+
+def decoded(start, size):
+    off = pe.get_offset_from_rva(start - pe.OPTIONAL_HEADER.ImageBase)

+    rc = c.get("return_code")
